items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: So George Jaffe was a leader for the Lanin office at the affair at the Waldorf Astoria.

ctx.x: I see, okay. Let's see now. You were with Jeter-Pillars and then there was Armstrong gave you the call -- around when was that? That was about when? 1944?

You know, I've got a cute story to tell you at the time I could not make the job with Lester Lanin. We'll cover Lester Lanin later. But it's fresh in memory, and one time I could not make the job and they had a little trombone player, small Italian dark sub-trombone player, in the band. So George Jaffe was a leader for the Lanin office at the affair at the Waldorf Astoria. So I'm pretty well known with all the people that come to them ballrooms. They ask about me, if they don't see me they ask Mr. Lanin or they…
